status: retrospective diagnostic; all original briefs already seen during development
review: review.json is fixed before running the counterfactuals; assistant judgments are not human labels or training data

experiments.rule: For an eligible source with recorded generator parents, require an exact prefix+suffix spelling reconstruction with at least three letters from each parent. Keep other sources unchanged.
Same as three_letters, and require at least one whole parent in the reconstruction.

limits: Reconstruction from frozen parent words is a spelling-based counterfactual, not the original phonetic cut, not measured recognizability. Missing ancestry abstains. No reranking, weights, candidate blacklist, threshold search or changed generator budget.
retentionGate: Do not adopt a rule that removes any of the pre-recorded assistant shortlist sources without another eligible source, or that fails to surface any of the buried choices. Passing this is necessary only, never a human quality pass.
